svg.text: P2-1 Function x system capability heat map
12 rows (11 identity functions + the IDTx concept) x 8 real-world identity systems. COMPARISON.md §2 (as of 2026-10-31).

S7 is the only system with createDID/resolve/rotate/delegate/execute all Native (the identifier is a key, the registry is contract-readable). createPresentation has no native ERC (Composed anchor on S7). The IDTx row is the

contribution boundary: only S7/S8 evaluate an identity dependency inside a transaction; S1-S6 make an off-chain identity-dependent DECISION (Absent on-chain), not a transaction. Source: COMPARISON.md §2 (as of 2026-10-31).

Note: §2 collapses attribute set/revoke into one row and gives the relayed/sponsored meta-tx no row (n-a/Absent except S7/S8 Composed, per §2 prose); it is therefore not shown as a row here. Glyph+label+shade all encode class.
